articles.title: Infinite Orbits acquires UK startup Lunasa to expand satellite servicing capabilities
articles.summary:

articles.title: Major Artemis Shift Leaves Questions About SLS, Gateway Future
articles.summary: In a major announcement Friday, 27 February, NASA announced a revision of the Artemis Program architecture. To accommodate the change, the design of the SLS rocket will be significantly reworked.
